capabilities: Syncs notes and attachments to a Supabase project in real time
Merges simultaneous edits to one note with live cursors
Keeps up to 50 versions per note and restores them
Saves conflict copies and restores deleted notes
Syncs themes, snippets, hotkeys and plugins across devices
disambiguation: Not a Supabase database client; it syncs vault files, attachments and settings to your own Supabase project.
extras: Unofficial sync method; the Supabase project can be hosted (free plan) or self-hosted with Docker. Password and access token are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, and the README states there is no tracking or analytics.
intentEvidence: this is an unofficial way to sync and back up your notes. Obsidian Sync is the official option
problem: Local vault files alone cannot stay in sync across devices, and two devices cannot edit the same note at the same time without overwriting each other.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault with your own Supabase project
